propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close without appended completion signature from one closed with the gate off because close provenance is ephemeral and discarded

The completion_expectation enum (8 values: required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be persisted present-only on the *->closed STATUS event in the same single locked write as the close to durably record close provenance

The expectation is computed by _completion_precheck as a returned pair alongside verified_result, with gate state resolving first so forced close under disabled/unreadable config records gate_off/gate_unreadable rather than force_bypassed
The idea->closed path (REJECT/DROP) must explicitly set not_applicable in close_ticket since it bypasses _completion_precheck entirely

A reader combining durable expectation with durable attestation can distinguish: required+attestation=signed; required+none=signature lost; disposition+/-attestation=disposition-signed/lost; anything else=not expected
The field is backward-compatible and present-only: legacy close events lacking it reduce to state with the key absent (unknown, never guessed); no migration required
